newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler increases Q2 output forecast.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler increases Q2 output forecast.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said on Wednesday it projects second quarter worldwide production at 818,200, up from the previous forecast of 809,000.
The new forecast calls for production of 570,200 light trucks, versus 564,300 in the previous schedule. Car output is now expected to be 248,000, up from 244,700.
For the first quarter, Chrysler produced a total of 762,100 vehicles. That is slightly below the 765,700 vehicles the automaker had said it would make.
In the 1996 second quarter, Chrysler produced 775,800 cars and trucks. It made 743,200 vehicles the first quarter of 1996.
